info.title: Stella Atlas API
info.description:
Stella Atlas REST API. Public catalog, published guides and health endpoints allow anonymous reads. Admin endpoints require a database-backed HttpOnly session cookie and server-side permissions.

Catalog responses use `{data}` or `{data, meta}`. Health responses use `{status}`. Errors use `{error: {code, message, requestId, details}}`. Only active games and published catalog records are public. Collection queries reject unknown fields. Pagination defaults to page 1 and limit 20 (maximum 100).

Admin login: GET `/api/v1/admin/auth/csrf`, keep its cookie, then POST `/api/v1/admin/auth/login` with JSON credentials and `X-CSRF-Token`. Every mutation requires an allowed `Origin`. Subsequent mutations use the CSRF token from the login/session response. Cookie storage is automatic in browsers; do not put session tokens in localStorage. Role changes revoke sessions. Auth/admin responses are no-store.

Every response carries `X-Request-Id`. Session expiry/rotation, RBAC, game grants and draft-only editor rules are enforced server-side. Guide CMS supports immutable revisions, review, approval, publish/unpublish, archive and restore. ADMIN/EDITOR/REVIEWER permissions and game grants apply. Authors cannot approve their own revision. Published snapshots remain visible while newer drafts change. Every CMS mutation requires expectedRevision equal to the latest content version (not the body snapshot number currentRevision). A stale token returns 409 CONFLICT. Admin previews and revision history are authenticated, no-store and noindex.
